scene.metaphor: Two differently spaced ribbons of stitched fabric and punched labels are being aligned to a shared metal coordinate rail, like human spans and machine tokens finally agreeing on the same track.
scene.setting: A polished studio tabletop miniature that feels like an editorial model set: cool gray base surface, a short linear rail running horizontally through a wide, airy frame, with soft shadowed negative space around it.
scene.frozen_incident: Tal is mid-adjustment, one hand pinning a paper clip onto the rail while the other steadies a slightly overrun ribbon; a second ribbon has just slipped one notch out of alignment, creating a harmless, precise little mess that he is calmly fixing.
physical_materials: two stitched textile ribbons with uneven spacing
small binder clips and map pins
translucent acetate label tabs in cobalt and mint
one restrained warm accent thread or clip in muted coral
tiny scale markers etched into the rail
scene.image_instruction: Create a serious, polished studio photograph of a miniature alignment set on a cool-gray tabletop. Tal Perry appears as a recognizable adult operator, matching the supplied photos: dark curly hair, salt-and-pepper beard, friendly focused face, wearing a simple muted tank or tee. He is leaning in from the left side of a wide horizontal frame, carefully pinning two tactile fabric ribbons to one shared brushed-aluminum rail. One ribbon has larger, irregular spacing between stitched tabs; the other is more tightly segmented, and a single tab has just slipped slightly out of place, frozen at the instant he notices and corrects it. Use only three large supporting props: the rail, the two ribbons, and a small stack of acetate label tabs. Keep the background spacious and uncluttered, with strong tonal separation, crisp studio lighting, and cobalt/mint accents against the cool-gray foundation plus one restrained warm coral detail. The composition must read clearly at thumbnail size and stretch naturally into a 3:1 banner with lateral action and no tall central tower.
